captured_via: gh 2.98.0, live public board (org-owned Projects v2), owner/repo/ids anonymized; shapes verbatim
notes: There is no per-item read verb: `gh project` exposes item-list only, so fetch pages the board and filters locally — hence the explicit --limit.
Field VALUES are keyed by the field's display name at the item's top level (`status`, `linked pull requests`), NOT nested under a `fields` object.
`content.repository` is `owner/name`; the sibling top-level `repository` is a full URL. add_comment needs the former.
A draft item's `content` carries title/body/type only — no number, repository, or url.

`totalCount` is the board's REAL item count, independent of --limit — the only way a client-side filter can tell 'past the page we read' from 'not on this board'. The adapter's not-found message branches on it.
`item-list` never returns ARCHIVED items and has no flag to include them, so an archived item is indistinguishable from an absent one.
